description: Owned-game assets only: native item_0 UI icons where they exist; otherwise renders of the item's own model/textures. No generated artwork, no fighter portraits.

provenance.size: 64x64 RGBA (pane is aspect-fit to 64x64; visual parity with the previous 96 px icons is unreviewed)
provenance.private: Raw captures, decoded textures and pre-fit renders are kept outside the repo.
